title: An API gateway

requests.name: GET /api/users/1 is forwarded to the users service
a 404 from the users service is passed through
GET /api/orders/2 is forwarded to the orders service
a 404 from the orders service is passed through
/api/usersettings does not match the users route
an unknown path is the gateway's own 404

hints: A route matches when path === prefix or path.startsWith(prefix + "/").
The path for the service is the request path without the leading /api: req.url.slice("/api".length).
Pass the answer through: const body = await upstream.text(); res.writeHead(upstream.status, { "Content-Type": "application/json" }); res.end(body);
For /health, call both with Promise.all, and catch errors inside the helper so that one failure does not reject the whole thing.
